page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz, configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores ranking in the top 25 percent. However, multi-core performance and memory bandwidth scale to average levels, as shown by stress-ng multi-core and large-block memory read and write benchmarks. The instance exhibits weaker performance in memory-bound and highly concurrent workloads, with cached small-block memory bandwidth, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and software compilation with Clang falling into the bottom 25 percent.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance represents a standard general-purpose resource profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that rely heavily on single-threaded CPU performance but do not demand high memory throughput or local storage. Suitable workloads include text processing, basic web serving, and lightweight single-threaded applications, whereas database operations and high-throughput Redis deployments may be constrained by the weaker database and memory bandwidth performance.
